loop_construction: Exactly 32 s, native 48 kHz stereo, no terminal fade; periodic synthesis and modulation

files.intention: Quiet isolation: slow crossfaded pads, wide restrained glints, sparse low mechanical pulse

loudness.measurement: Installed ffmpeg ebur128 with true-peak oversampling; not human listening

loop_seam_checks.method: Integer-cycle oscillators, periodic modulation/envelopes and FFT noise/filtering; compare PCM wrap step/slope against normal local changes and quantization floor
loop_seam_checks.interpretation: Numerical seam check only. Adjacent first/last PCM samples need not be equal for a continuous periodic waveform. Auditory loop check is pending.
